_game: Boing! (Pong: the Code the Classics game, against its computer player)
_note: Setup: the `boing` extra (pip install boing-gym). The env is BoingHuman-v0 from boing-gym: the book's game with Pygame Zero taken out -- its rules, sprites, computer opponent and sound effects, one step per frame of its 60 Hz loop -- so the block runs real-time at fps 60 (speeds are pixels per frame; a lower fps is a slower game). Sound is on by default and plays through the session's audio output; set 'audio': false in the game phase without an audio device. One block is one match, over when a score passes 9 (typically 1-3 min); the book's menu and game-over screens are the message phases around it.
_keys_note: Env action space Discrete(3): 0 stay, 1 up, 2 down, resolved from the keys held each frame. The defaults are the book's player-1 keys (boing_gym.DEFAULT_KEYS): UP/DOWN arrows or A/Z; 1/2 below are the button box. Keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

text: You play the LEFT bat against the computer.
Return the ball; the first to 10 points wins.
UP    or  A  or  1   move the bat up
DOWN  or  Z  or  2   move the bat down
Hitting the ball with the edge of the bat
sends it off at an angle.
